claims.text: If reactive arthritis was triggered by C. trachomatis, doxycycline 100 mg orally twice a day for up to 3 months may accelerate recovery, but this is controversial.
claims.quote: If induced by infection with C. trachomatis,, doxycycline 100 mg orally 2 times a day for up to 3 months may accelerate recovery, but this is controversial.
